caption: The drawing depicts a round ceramic plate viewed from above, featuring a tan or light brown base color with a thin, darker brown rim. The plate's surface is decorated with a symmetrical, central motif comprising four fan-shaped leaves or petals branching out horizontally from a vertical axis. These fan shapes are divided into pairs, one pair above the other, with two at the top and two lower down; each pair is connected by curved, spiraling lines and bordered by additional leafy decorations. The fan shapes and embellishments are rendered in a reddish-brown outline, with intricate line work suggesting veins and texture within the fans. A fine, wavy border runs just inside the rim of the plate. The artist's signature, "CHARLOTTE ANGUS," appears in small, neat capital letters at the bottom right outside the plate's rim. The background of the image is off-white and unadorned.
title: Pa. German Pie Dish
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
